title: SDOF：通过状态约束调度驯服多智能体编排中的对齐税
summary: SDOF框架将多智能体执行视为受约束的状态机，通过在线RLHF意图路由器和状态感知调度器实现可审计的执行控制。在招聘系统基准测试中，7B模型在对抗性路由任务上准确率达80.9%（GPT-4o为48.9%），端到端任务完成率86.5%，并完全阻止了注入攻击。
summary_en: SDOF treats multi-agent execution as a constrained state machine, using an online-RLHF intent router and state-aware dispatcher for auditable control. On a recruitment benchmark, a 7B model achieves 80.9% routing accuracy (vs 48.9% for GPT-4o), 86.5% task completion, and blocks all injection attacks.
